title: Do Guests Actually Like QR Code Menus?

scenes.say: Do guests actually like QR code menus?

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: I'm hungry. I just want to read a menu, not hunt for a signal on my phone.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: I want a menu, not a *scavenger hunt*.

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: The page wouldn't load, so I just ordered the first thing I saw. Two stars.
A QR menu is cheap to change, and some guests love it. But for others it's one more hurdle before they can eat.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.fact: Some love it. Others find it one more hurdle

scenes.say: So keep a few paper menus at the host stand. Test the code on bad Wi-Fi. And have servers offer both.

props.title: The fix
steps: Test the code on bad Wi-Fi
